name: Multi-pass GPU Ray-Casting with Early Ray Termination
aliases: Multi-pass GPU Raycaster with Early Ray Termination and Empty Space Skipping
definition: A multi-pass rendering approach that casts rays of sight through a volume for each fragment, using depth replace and early z-test to skip computations when an opacity threshold is reached or an iso-value is hit.
summary: Multi-pass GPU Ray-Casting with Early Ray Termination is a stream-based rendering technique that splits ray traversal across multiple passes to enable early termination and empty-space skipping, solving the lack of dynamic flow control in older GPU hardware.
